pages.text: $(l)Spartan Weaponry$(): daggers, spears, halberds, longbows and more, in every material.$(br2)$(l)Spartan Shields$(): more shields.

Every weapon counts as one or more categories: sword, light, two-handed, polearm, axe, blunt, scythe (hoes too), thrown, bow, crossbow or magic. Skill perks boost their categories.$(br2)Hover a weapon to see its damage with your skills; hold $(l)Shift$() for the breakdown and its categories.
pages.title: Weapon Types
